related.title: CLIP：影文對比與溫度校準
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付三元組表、零截斷測試與採樣診斷。；.1與.05正確，.7案例損失0，平方距離及margin定義一致。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver triplet tables, zero-clamp tests and sampling diagnostics.; Losses.1,.05 and zero at.7 match with consistent squared-distance conventions.
related.difference: 畫兩圖兩文字的相似度矩陣，標對角配對；區分影到文列正規化與文到影欄正規化。；兩機率值誤差小於1e−6，列欄損失方向與配對索引皆有測試。
related.differenceEn: Draw a two-image/two-text matrix with diagonal pairs; distinguish row image-to-text from column text-to-image normalization.; Both probabilities agree within1e−6, with tests for loss direction and pairing indices.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: L=max(0,dAP²−dAN²+margin)，必須一致使用平方距離。；教學dAP²=.4,dAN²=.5,margin=.2；改負樣本平方距離.55。；L=.4−.5+.2=.1；改後.4−.55+.2=.05，兩者均大於0。
兩候選相似度差Δ以溫度τ形成p=1/(1+exp(−Δ/τ))；僅為一列二候選示例。；教學相似度.8與.2，τ=.2，改τ=.4。；p=1/(1+exp(−3))=.952574；τ.4得.817574。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: L=max(0,dAP²−dAN²+margin), consistently using squared distances.; Teaching dAP²=.4,dAN²=.5,margin=.2; change negative squared distance to.55.; L=.4−.5+.2=.1; changed loss=.05, both above zero.
For two candidates with similarity gap Δ, p=1/(1+exp(−Δ/τ)); this is one row of a two-candidate example.; Teaching similarities.8 and.2, τ=.2 then.4.; p=1/(1+exp(−3))=.952574; τ.4 gives.817574.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Longformer：局部視窗與全域Token
related.titleEn: Longformer: local windows and global tokens
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付三元組表、零截斷測試與採樣診斷。；.1與.05正確，.7案例損失0，平方距離及margin定義一致。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver triplet tables, zero-clamp tests and sampling diagnostics.; Losses.1,.05 and zero at.7 match with consistent squared-distance conventions.
related.difference: 在16token小模型列半徑2局部鄰居，再加入一全域token，將重複邊用集合去除。；33792及66560正確，真實有限序列沒有環狀洩漏，重疊邊不重複計數。
related.differenceEn: For16 tokens list radius-two neighbors, add one global token and deduplicate edges as a set.; Counts match; finite sequences have no wraparound leakage and duplicate edges are removed.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: L=max(0,dAP²−dAN²+margin)，必須一致使用平方距離。；教學dAP²=.4,dAN²=.5,margin=.2；改負樣本平方距離.55。；L=.4−.5+.2=.1；改後.4−.55+.2=.05，兩者均大於0。
為避免邊界與重疊雙算，本教學只算環狀局部視窗：每query含自己共w個key，總Lw；真實全域邊需另外去重。；教學L1024,w33；比較w65，環狀僅作計數模型。；E=1024×33=33792；w65時66560。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: L=max(0,dAP²−dAN²+margin), consistently using squared distances.; Teaching dAP²=.4,dAN²=.5,margin=.2; change negative squared distance to.55.; L=.4−.5+.2=.1; changed loss=.05, both above zero.

This teaching count isolates a circular local window of w keys including self, totaling Lw; real global edges require separate deduplication.; Teaching L1024,w33 versus65; circular boundaries are a counting model only.; E=1024×33=33792; w65 gives66560.
